issues.description: v1.0 froze a uniform float32 / autocast-OFF / inference_mode protocol for ALL components. The frozen canonical G extraction actually runs under autocast(float16) with torch.no_grad() and inference_mode=FALSE.

v1.0 treated 'ALWAYS_REFINE' as the gated full graph. The frozen predecessor semantics define the literal C2 ALWAYS_REFINE anchor as MAC(G) + MAC(R_psi) with NO router (routing bypassed); the gated K=N_eligible graph retains router overhead and must be labelled separately.
